_note: Prototype, not calibrated. Reception is a geometric function of the receiver's first_touch (Plane A, L0.11 §7.2), his freedom at launch, and the pass distance. Flight speed scales with the passer's passing. No dice (ADR-035; foundation §5). Calibration (L3) is the reference study; until then the values are declared choices. Since SIM_VERSION 52 (ADR-051) speed_base_cm_per_tick and speed_passing_bonus_cm_per_tick are no longer read: the pass is weighed by the kick (kick.json). Removed-by: the pass kinds of ADR-051. The reception now happens where the pass reaches a player, not after a fixed time. The first touch (2026-11-13, plan L0-CLOSE 11): the ball he wins keeps first_touch_keep_max x (1 - first_touch) of the speed it came with, and runs on from where he took it; he goes after it, and until his foot is on it again it is anyone's. The best first touch kills it; a ball at rest he brings under his foot in a step.
_source: Prototype. Speed base 150 and passing bonus 150 reproduce the old prototype's flight range (~150-300 cm/tick). freedom_ref_cm matches PASS_FREEDOM_CM in state.rs. distance_ref_cm is a typical pass length (~30 m). control_threshold_milli 400/1000: a player with first_touch >= 0.4 controls in neutral situations; higher first_touch or more freedom gives margin; a very long or contested reception fails. loose_control_radius_cm 100 (ADR-041 §5, 2026-11-12): a loose ball within about a stride of a player is his; arbitrary, declared, to be calibrated at L3. first_touch_keep_max_milli: arbitrary, declared (the worst professional's control of a pass arriving at 6 m/s lets it run on about 2 m), to be sourced at L3.
